messages:
kevin: Heads-up — invoice preview shows ~600 unsettled credits for tenant md-203. looks like duplicate metering events from a fallback-routing fanout.

billing-bot: Alert: invoice_preview_unsettled_credits tenant=md-203 count=598 reason=fallback_duplicate ts=2026-03-18T22:11:03Z

kevin: Timeline: yesterday around 22:10 we had a spike that triggered fallback to small-models and the router seems to have emitted two events for many requests. @sam can you eyeball route-fingerprint and proxy retry path?

sam: On it. quick q — are the duplicates appearing before enrichment (router) or after (ingest/enrich)? need a log sample.

marta: I pulled the preview pipeline: two events with same request_id but different route_tag reached billing after enrichment. suspect the enrichment sidecar attaches plan tags and causes fanout to different enrich paths.

helen: UX note: console previews look alarming when counts spike. can we show a "staged vs final" credit column and link to raw events so CS/product don't escalate?

kevin: short term mitigation: can we add a dedupe key that includes request_id+session_id in postproc? @ops-bot any chance to add a quick dedupe rule?

ops-bot: Runbook: applying postproc dedupe window=5m for tenant=md-203. Will drop events with identical (request_id, session_id) if seen within window. Patching now and tailing logs.

sam: Found root cause in router logs — retry code path did a blind resend when upstream ack delayed, and enrichment sidecar produced different route_tag for the retry. Fix: make retries preserve idempotency by adding a retry_seq or idempotency header.

kevin: For immediacy we need a correction on the invoice preview (subtract the duplicates) and flag preview so CS knows it's reconciled. can we run a reconcile backfill?

marta: I'll spin up a small reconcile job. Plan: dedupe by request_id where count>1 during the window and adjust preview amount + add console_note.

kevin: paste the SQL if you have it.

marta: ```sql
WITH dup AS (
  SELECT request_id, tenant_id, ARRAY_AGG(id) AS ids, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM billing_events
  WHERE tenant_id='md-203' AND created_at >= '2026-03-18 00:00:00'::timestamptz
  GROUP BY request_id, tenant_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
UPDATE invoice_preview p
SET adj_note = 'dedup applied', amount = amount - (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ev.tokens),0) FROM events ev WHERE ev.id = ANY(dup.ids)
)
FROM dup WHERE p.tenant_id=dup.tenant_id;
```

sam: I'll follow up with a router patch to attach `idempotency_key` and set retry_seq so enrichment sees the same routing. test plan: unit + e2e with a proxy timeout stub.

kevin: :thumbsup: Timeline: ops patch now, reconcile job + console note within the hour, code fix in next sprint.

billing-bot: Notice: invoice_preview update succeeded for tenant md-203, preview id=ip_20260318_009, adjusted -598 tokens.

helen: for UX follow-up let's add a 'reconcile' action in the preview UI that runs dedupe heuristics and shows the before/after delta. also surface a link to the reconcile run logs.

kevin: filing tickets: ENG-PLAT-927 (postproc dedupe hotfix), ENG-PLAT-928 (router retry idempotency), ENG-UX-634 (preview reconcile action). owners next?

marta: Assigned ENG-PLAT-927 to me.

sam: ENG-PLAT-928 assigned to me. I'll draft a PR today.

kevin: Thanks all — keep updates here if anything new shows up in other tenants.
